newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spotless Group sets bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spotless Group sets bonus issue.

text.p: Catering and building services group Spotless Group ltd said on Friday it had set a bonus issue of ordinary shares in the ratio of one new share for every nine existing shares.
These shares will rank equally with all fully paid ordinary shares for all future dividends. The first entitlement will be to any dividend for the half year to 31 December 1996.

Directors said they expect the 69 percent-owned Spotless Services Limited to sustain satisfactory profit growth into the fiscal year 1996/97 and that the wholly owned plastics division would also generate profit growth.
The established normal dividend payout ratio policy was expected to be maintained.
Spotless Group shares closed two cents down at A$2.42 on turnover of 38,461 shares.
